gates.requirement: P0–P5 were merged to main in dependency order on August 11, 2026; source publication does not authorize a stable release.
Review the actual toolbar browser-action popup in a normal unmanaged supported Chrome installation.
Keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, motion, focus visibility, and cognitive-usability review.
Multi-day service-worker, retention, alarm, report, notification, storage-pressure, browser-update, and restart review.
Review labeled real-site false positives and false negatives beyond the curated regression corpus.
Review live provider behavior, account routing, cost, retention, payload handling, failure states, and model responses with a dedicated test credential.
Review real peer exchange, abuse resistance, authenticity limits, replay/flood behavior, connection metadata, relay/signaling dependencies, and disconnect cleanup.
Independent extension-security and privacy assessment; automated source, package, browser, and advisory gates are insufficient.

Withdraw or rewrite the stale public v1.0.0 GitHub release and audit tags, release assets, Chrome Web Store drafts/listings, demos, submissions, videos, downloads, portfolio, and social copy. Repository issue #7 tracks the confirmed release blocker.
Required before making compliance claims or deploying in a regulated context.
Approve the exact candidate artifact hash, release notes, limitations, known issues, rollback/withdrawal plan, and every preceding required gate.
